title: A part moved onto a no-charge line loses its price and keeps its cost
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 holding one stock part costing $40.00 and priced $60.00, and line 2 No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Move line 1's part onto line 2.
  3. Open the Notes tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 1's part shows $60.00.

Step 2:

  • On line 2 the part shows $0.00 and its cost $40.00.

Step 3:

  • A note records the move and the price.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E6: “A part moved between lines follows the line it lands on, as if added there: onto a billable line it is priced from its cost by the pricing rules; onto a no-charge line its price is removed and its cost stays; the posting is decided at invoice creation by the line it is on then, so nothing is reclassed while the work order is open; the note records the move and the price.”
